title: Preserve independent chord display flags
scope: Retain ShowName, ShowDiagram and ShowFingering on scoped chord definitions.
acceptance: Test all three flags independently, including false values rather than only absent defaults.
Two otherwise identical scoped definitions with different visibility remain distinct.
Public changes and GP8 export produce matching independent consumer flags.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Reproduced at tracks[0].staves[0].bars[87].voices[0].beats[0].chord.showFingering. Source and target values are stored in probe_comparison.
All eight flag combinations on otherwise identical definitions in two staff scopes, plus isolated repeated-definition edits.
Hash-bound source and actual exported artifacts, strict report and raw final consumer facts.

resolution: Implemented independent occurrence-owned ShowName, ShowDiagram and ShowFingering pointers. All eight explicit boolean combinations, staff scope overrides, repeated definitions, absent controls and direct edits retain exact final pinned-consumer flags. Legacy Chord.Show remains separate. Awaiting fresh different-agent review and integrated gates/probe.
verification: Valid strict public source regression fails against the previous model reader (missing display values) and passes with this implementation.
Exact public fields, 48 serialized property name/type/value assertions and all raw source/edited consumer flags pass.
Source defaults and legacy empty-diagram string fallback are explicit in the receipt; no render appearance claim.
Full conformance, capability probe and prek remain assigned to root integration.
